summary: The post-shutdown harness ran (CheckRun d5ac2dbfe86e438f8cd995156206efe2, exit 0) and answered the response-completion gap with a within-run control. While the node was live, the same fast-path delivery received a response with Success true and the node's term moved from 2 to 3, so the delivery really reaches the production handler and the operand reacts when the handler runs. After Shutdown, with the node in state Shutdown at term 3 and its transport deliberately left open, the identical delivery received nothing: the bounded wait expired after 2000 ms and the term stayed at 3, which is the operand that makes this more than a timed-out request, since an unchanged term shows the handler returned before running appendEntries. That matches the shutdown check at the top of processHeartbeat returning without responding while the dispatcher waits on the response channel it supplied and whose only escape is the transport's own shutdown. So an RPC accepted on the fast path has no completion path once the receiver is down, and the caller is released only when the transport closes; this is the same shape as the earlier accepted-apply-duty finding, reached through a different door. I kept the severity honest and scoped: in the ordinary lifecycle a caller that waits on the shutdown future closes the transport and releases the waiter, and that future is the documented way to wait, so the exposure sits in the window a caller opens by shutting the node down without waiting, and in the peer whose connection goroutine is parked while the receiver's transport outlives the node, with the cluster-level consequence limited to a stalled per-peer heartbeat. I recorded the behaviour and the observation with its receipt, answered only the response-completion gap, and left the broader harmful-consequence gap open; I also recorded on the investigation why it is not deterministically witnessable here - it needs the off-thread store to land inside a two-instruction read-modify-write in the candidate path, and this backend has no race detector - while noting that the narrower facet was witnessable precisely because it needs no interleaving. The four earlier witnessed findings remain recorded and unaffected.
